cost: O(path bytes+ancestor canonicalization syscalls) resolution; OS byte I/O costs; read_dir sort O(k log k), memory O(names+data). No measured speed claim.
description: Confined DirFs and explicit unrestricted RealFs adapters.
forward: DirFs.new canonicalizes existing directory. real_path normalizes virtual components, joins root, checks canonical deepest existing ancestor; final symlinks require canonical target inside root. with runs OS operation after check then logs result; RealFs.with directly applies OS operation.
inverse: Canonical target admits symlink/path aliases and unknown prior host contents. Error/zero-byte journal does not recover actual payload. Metadata projection loses native ctime,nlink and directory-entry inode.
limitations: Finite checks only; partial source syntax, no expanded semantic AST.
No numerical surrogate: categorical/effect semantics lack useful metric; future caps 1/2/5/10 require domain and reference.
state: Under stable filesystem and safe temp prefix, DirFs regular access remains rooted; TOCTOU invalidates concurrent adversarial confinement. Metadata reports ctime=mtime,nlink1; host logs bytes0. remove_dir_all rejects exact root.
